user.title: Connect Matrix
user.description: Connect a Matrix account. The password is used only once to obtain an access token and is not stored. Keep end-to-end encryption enabled unless you intentionally use unencrypted rooms.

data.require_e2ee: Require end-to-end encryption for target rooms

data_description.default_room: Room ID (!...) or room alias (#...). Used when an action does not specify Rooms or Route.
data_description.allowed_users: Fail-closed sender allowlist for incoming events.
data_description.allowed_rooms: Fail-closed room allowlist for incoming events. Both user and room must match.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Matrix homeserver
error.invalid_room: The default room alias or ID is invalid

abort.already_configured: This Matrix account is already configured

init.title: Matrix Extended settings
init.description: Choose a section. Matrix Extended settings are graphical; JSON or YAML is not required for integration setup.

general.title: General
general.description: Change the default Matrix room, TLS validation and E2EE policy. Saving reloads the integration.

data_description.default_room: Room ID (!...) or alias (#...). Aliases are validated before saving.
data_description.verify_ssl: Keep enabled for normal HTTPS Matrix homeservers.
data_description.require_e2ee: Reject sends to target rooms that are not encrypted.

incoming.title: Incoming & security
incoming.description: Control which incoming Matrix events Home Assistant may process. When incoming events are enabled, both allowlists must be non-empty.

data_description.allowed_users: Only events from these Matrix user IDs are processed.
data_description.allowed_rooms: Only events from these Matrix rooms are processed. Both user and room must match.

media.title: Incoming media
media.description: Control downloading, retention and disk usage for incoming Matrix attachments.

data_description.incoming_media_retention_days: 0 disables age-based cleanup. The storage limit still applies.
data_description.incoming_media_max_mb: Maximum total size of the incoming-media directory.

routes.title: Notification routes
routes.description: Manage named room groups graphically. Actions can use a route name instead of repeating Matrix room IDs.

data_description.route_rooms: One or more Matrix room IDs or aliases.

route_edit_details.title: Edit {route_name}
route_edit_details.description: Change the Matrix rooms used by route {route_name}.

route_delete.title: Delete route
route_delete.description: Delete a saved route. Automations that reference the deleted route must be updated.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to validate the Matrix room with the current connection settings
error.invalid_room: The room alias or ID is invalid
error.required_when_incoming: Required while incoming events are enabled
error.route_exists: A route with this name already exists
error.route_needs_rooms: Add at least one Matrix room

send.name: Send Matrix message
send.description: Send text and structured rich media with E2EE, formatting, mentions, threads, updateable notifications and safe reaction actions.

target.name: Rooms
target.description: Matrix room IDs or aliases. Empty uses the default room.

route.name: Route
route.description: Named route from Matrix Extended settings. Do not use together with Rooms.

notification_key.name: Notification key
notification_key.description: Stable key used to edit the same Matrix event on later sends.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text body; optional when only media is sent.

msgtype.name: Message type
msgtype.description: Matrix text, notice or emote type.

mention_users.name: Mention users
mention_users.description: Matrix user IDs for native mentions.

thread_id.name: Thread ID
thread_id.description: Matrix event ID of the thread root.

media.name: Advanced media
media.description: Structured list of entities/cameras, paths, URLs or Media Source IDs with media metadata.

actions.name: Reaction actions
actions.description: Explicit Home Assistant actions that allowed Matrix reactions may trigger.

send_media.name: Send Matrix media
send_media.description: Open the Home Assistant Media Browser and send an item from Local Media, Frigate or another Media Source provider.

media_picker.name: Choose media
media_picker.description: Browse all Home Assistant Media Source providers.

voice.name: Voice message
voice.description: Mark selected audio as a native Matrix voice message.

send_voice.name: Send Matrix voice message
send_voice.description: Synthesize text with Home Assistant TTS and send it as a native Matrix voice message.

tts_engine.name: TTS engine
tts_engine.description: Home Assistant tts.* entity; empty uses the default.

language.name: Language
language.description: Requested language; compatible locale variants are matched automatically.

transcribe_voice.name: Transcribe Matrix voice
transcribe_voice.description: Transcribe downloaded Matrix voice through Home Assistant STT and optionally pass the transcript to Assist.

path.name: Incoming voice path
path.description: local_path from matrix_extended_media or a filename in this account's incoming-media directory.

stt_entity.name: STT entity
stt_entity.description: Home Assistant stt.* entity; empty uses the default.

assist.name: Run Home Assistant Assist
assist.description: Explicitly pass the transcript to Conversation/Assist.

send_location.name: Send Matrix location
send_location.description: Send Matrix location data from coordinates or a Home Assistant entity.

entity_id.name: Location entity
entity_id.description: Entity with latitude and longitude attributes.

reply.name: Reply to Matrix event
reply.description: Reply to an existing Matrix event using its event ID.

react.name: React to Matrix event
react.description: Add an emoji or text reaction to an existing Matrix event.

edit.name: Edit Matrix message
edit.description: Replace a previously sent text-like Matrix event.

redact.name: Redact Matrix event
redact.description: Redact an existing event from a Matrix room.

purge_media.name: Purge downloaded Matrix media
purge_media.description: Delete downloaded incoming Matrix media for one account and return removed file/byte counts.
